review.title: Sell or add
review.intro: Every holding scored on quality and price and sized against your book: what to sell, trim or add, and what to buy outside. Search a ticker below to weigh it.
review.unpriced: {count} position(s) without a price, held at cost
review.empty_body: Import your transactions or follow a few tickers, and this page will say what to sell, what to add to and what to buy.
review.locked_title: Import your portfolio to see your plan
review.locked_body: This page scores each of your holdings and says what to sell, trim or add to. Behind it, an example.
review.plan_even: The sales pay for the adds
review.plan_sells_help: Money freed by every sell and trim below, at today's prices.
review.plan_buys_help: Money to take each 'add' to its target and open the outside buys. What the sales free goes first to your best cheap names.
review.plan_net_help: Adds minus sales. If they need more than the sales free, it takes new money; if less, cash is left with no home in your book.
review.plan_unplaced: {amount} from the sales has no home in your book: see the 'Buy' candidates below or an index fund.
review.plan_chart_note: Total return in {base} since the window's first day, beside the S&P 500. What sells draws warm, what adds draws cool. The past says nothing of what comes.
review.plan_chart_empty: No price history for these names over this window.
review.plan_chart_more: The three biggest of each side; {count} more not drawn.
review.note_few_names: You hold {count} names: concentration is your book's shape, not one position's fault, so nothing is trimmed for it. Add tickers above to weigh candidates.
review.note_sector_heavy: {sector} is {weight} of your book across {count} names: what the sales free goes elsewhere. See 'Buy' candidates from other sectors.
review.note_crypto_heavy: Crypto is {weight} of your book. Nothing here scores or cuts it: your call how much a coin crash may take.
review.note_country_heavy: {count} names from {country} are {weight} of your book: one country drives almost all of the result.
review.note_country_heavy_help: Shown when one country is 70% or more across 3+ companies. It may be your own: a warning, not a verdict.
review.note_currency_heavy: {weight} of your book is quoted in {currency}: your result also moves with the exchange rate.
review.note_currency_heavy_help: Shown when one currency other than the page's is 80% or more. Funds included.
review.note_fund_core: Funds are {weight} of your book: the {count} single names are satellites and are read as such.
review.note_fund_core_help: Shown when funds (not money market) are 60% or more. A fund is not scored: it is held as the core.
review.note_cash_heavy: Cash is {weight} of your book and there are {count} names to add to or buy.
review.note_cash_heavy_help: Shown when money market funds are 20% or more and the plan has buys. Holding cash may be your choice.
review.ccy_tag_help: Quoted in {currency}: its value in your currency also moves with the exchange rate.
review.note_tax_offset: Also selling {tickers}, now at a loss, would cut the plan's tax by about {amount}.
review.note_tax_offset_window: Buy it back before {date} and the loss does not count.
review.plan_tax_help: What the sales add to this year's tax bill ({code}), on your own lots and gains already booked.
review.move_no_tax: No extra tax: the sale books a loss or is offset
review.buy_after: If you buy {ticker} back before {date}, you can't use the loss: it is deferred
review.map_help: Up is a better business, right is cheaper. The shaded corner is where 'add' and 'buy' live; the dashed lines are the verdict bars.
review.map_tap: hover over or tap a dot to see why; click it for everything
review.tip_more: Click, or tap again, for the full details
review.map_missing: {count} without a score (bets, funds, cash or missing data)
review.held_help: Positions that call for a move come first (sell, trim, add); then the ones you keep. Quality and price are 0–100 scores from the fundamentals on each ticker page.
review.outside_help: Your watchlist's names you do not hold, plus any ticker typed above. 'Buy' needs both a good business and a fair price.
review.outside_empty: No outside names yet: follow a ticker or type one in the box above.
review.coins: Crypto stays out of this read: a coin has no filings to score. It is {weight} of your book:
review.map_find_more: {count} more — keep typing to narrow it
review.col_quality_help: 0–100: ROIC, operating margin, FCF yield and moat (mature); rule of 40, gross margin and moat (fast grower). 60+ good; under 45 weak.
review.col_cheapness_help: 0–100, higher = cheaper: forward P/E (or per growth point), FCF yield, EV/EBITDA (mature); EV/sales per growth point, FCF (fast). 50+ cheap.
review.col_weight_help: This position's share of the priced book.
review.col_target_help: The weight the verdict takes it to: 0% to sell, an even share to cut a concentration, {add_to} to add.
review.col_move_help: Money to sell (−) or buy (+) to reach the target, at today's price.
review.col_tax_help: Extra tax this year if the sale is made, with your tax jurisdiction and lots.
review.col_pnl_help: Unrealised gain or loss on the position against its cost.
review.col_return_help: Total return in your currency over the window, dividends included.
review.col_vs_index_help: Points ahead (+) or behind (−) the S&P 500 over the same window and currency.
review.col_vs_sector_help: The same against its sector's ETF. Blank for funds.
review.metric_growth_pe_help: Forward P/E over sustained sales growth per share (net of dilution). 1x or under is cheap for its growth; 2.5x is dear.
review.metric_owner_fcf_yield_help: Free cash flow minus share-based pay, over market cap: the yield the scores use.
review.metric_roic_ex_goodwill_help: Return on the business's own capital, without the premium paid for acquisitions or its amortisation. The quality score uses it.
review.metric_revenue_growth_help: Revenue growth over the last year, from the quote source.
review.metric_fcf_margin_help: Free cash flow as a share of revenue: how much of each sale is left as cash.
review.metric_runway_years_help: Cash and short-term investments over last year's cash burn: years before it needs new money. Blank for a business that makes cash.
review.ask_help: Opens a new chat and asks about what is on screen, filters included.
review.prompt_intro: Review this sell-or-add read of my portfolio ({date}, in {base}) and challenge it.
review.prompt_held: Held (verdict, weight → target, quality/price out of 100, reasons, figures):
review.prompt_ask: Start with the plan as a whole: where the cash comes from if I buy more than I sell, how concentrated the book ends up, and what tax it triggers, including the repurchase-after-loss rule. Then, for each name: what the filter misses and which figure, with a concrete threshold, would change the decision. A name is a buy or a sell, never both. Finish with the order you would do it in. Check the current figures yourself and mark any you cannot check as unverified.
review.filter_weight_help: Only holdings have a weight; outside names follow the sector filter alone.
review.filter_include_help: What to compare: your book, your starred names, your whole watchlist or one of its groups. Picks add up; a ticker typed in above is always included.
review.disclaimer: A screen over your own records and public fundamentals, not advice. The scores miss what the filings do not show.
review.verdict_sell_help: Weak on both quality and price, or a position under {small} not good enough to grow into a real one. Target: 0%.
review.verdict_trim_help: A concentration ({concentrated}+), to an even share; or a weak business at 6%+ weight or 10%+ of risk, halved.
review.verdict_hold_help: Nothing to move now. If the business is weak, it is too small (under 6%) to trim.
review.verdict_add_help: Quality 60+, price 50+, no warning flag and under {add_to}: to {add_to}. When sales free money, up to an even share.
review.verdict_core_help: A fund: kept as the core, with no company's numbers to judge.
review.verdict_cash_help: Money market: parked cash, no business verdict.
review.verdict_buy_help: Not held, quality 60+, price 50+ and no warning flag: a good business at a good price.
review.verdict_watch_help: A good business still dear, or a decent one at a good price: wait for a better entry.
review.verdict_pass_help: Neither quality nor price clears the bar.
review.verdict_bet_help: A business still proving its product: little revenue or losing more than it sells. No score; held, it is capped at 3% of the book.
review.verdict_unrated_help: No reliable numbers to score: a fund, a coin, or fundamentals missing or broken at the source.
review.reason_quality_help: Quality score 60 or more (ROIC, operating margin, FCF yield and moat).
review.reason_cheap_help: Price score 50 or more (forward P/E or P/E per growth point, FCF yield, EV/EBITDA).
review.reason_high_roic_help: Return on invested capital of 25% or more.
review.reason_low_roic_help: Return on invested capital under 8%: barely covers its cost of capital.
review.reason_wide_moat_help: Moat score 70 or more: a durable competitive edge in the filings.
review.reason_negative_fcf_help: Free cash flow below zero: the business consumes cash.
review.reason_loss_making_help: Forward P/E at or below zero: analysts expect a loss next year.
review.reason_buybacks_help: Share count falling 2%+ a year: the company buys back its own stock.
review.reason_dilution_help: Share count growing 3%+ a year: your slice shrinks.
review.reason_high_debt_help: Net debt 3x EBITDA or more (5x utilities and telecoms, 8x REITs). Blocks add and buy: a cheap price may be the lenders' claim.
review.reason_growth_help: Revenue growing 20%+ a year, sustained: the lower of the last quarter on a year before and the multi-year rate.
review.reason_concentrated: too big a share of the book
review.reason_concentrated_help: Over the {concentrated} line, higher with few names. Cut to an even share; halfway if good and cheap, or unread.
review.reason_heavy_help: 6% or more of the book, short of the concentration line.
review.reason_few_names_help: With one or two names the weight is the book's shape: nothing is trimmed. Add candidates to spread it.
review.reason_redeploy_help: Good and cheap: the money from the sales above takes it (or opens it) to its target before it is left as cash.
review.reason_close_call_help: A few points from a sell or an add. A new move needs a margin; one already proposed stands to its line.
review.reason_sale_costly: selling costs more than it gains
review.reason_sale_costly_help: Weak, but not that weak: the tax would pass 5% of what the sale frees. Sold anyway with quality under 25.
review.reason_needs_new_money_help: Good and cheap, but the sales do not pay for it. If you add money, it goes here first.
review.stay_title: Your portfolio is fine as it is
review.stay_body: Nothing needs moving today. Not selling or buying is a decision too.
review.stay_close: {count} name(s) close to a move: they move once they clear their line by a margin.
review.stay_costly: {count} sale(s) on hold: the tax would eat what they bring.
review.wait_help: Adds the sales do not pay for, best first. Not counted in the plan.
review.reason_tax_staged: cut in two years for tax
review.reason_tax_staged_help: Selling it all now would cost 10%+ of the sale in tax: half the cut now, the rest next tax year.
review.reason_sector_full_help: Its sector is already 40%+ of the book: no add, and none of what the sales free goes here.
review.reason_risk_heavy_help: Carries 10% or more of the book's volatility.
review.reason_underweight_help: One of the best on both scores, yet under {add_to} of the book.
review.reason_small_help: Under {small} of the book: too small to move it. At most 5 are sold at a time, the weakest first.
review.reason_data_suspect_help: FCF yield over 25% or enterprise value at or below zero — almost always mixed currencies at the source. FCF and EV/EBITDA are ignored.
review.reason_no_data_help: The source has too few fundamentals to score it.
review.reason_fund_help: A fund or ETF: judged by what it holds, not here.
review.reason_crypto_help: A coin has no balance sheet or income statement to score.
review.reason_pre_revenue_help: Little or no revenue against its price (40x sales or more) and burning cash: the price is a bet on a product not yet sold.
review.reason_deep_burn_help: Operating loss larger than all its revenue, with cash going out: the sales do not cover the product yet, so it is judged as a bet, not on its ratios.
review.reason_trial_risk_help: Drug developer before sales: a failed trial or regulator's no can take most of the value. Size small.
review.reason_patent_risk_help: A drug maker lives on patents that expire: check when the main ones run out and what replaces them. Expiry dates are not in the data.
review.reason_growth_stage_help: Sales growing 25%+ a year with operating margin under 10%: judged on growth, gross margin and the rule of 40, not on today's profits.
review.reason_rule_of_40_help: Sales growth plus FCF margin is 40% or more: growth that pays for itself.
review.reason_short_runway_help: Cash covers under 1.5 years of the current burn: expect new shares or debt, often at a bad price.
review.reason_long_runway_help: Cash covers 3+ years of the current burn: time to reach the next milestone without raising.
review.reason_bet_heavy_help: A bet above 3% of the book: trimmed to 3%, so a failure costs a slice and not the year.
review.reason_fcf_float_help: FCF over twice EBITDA even net of share pay: customer money or advance payments. Not counted as yield.
review.reason_share_pay_help: Share-based pay is half or more of its free cash flow: the reported FCF counts it as free. Scored on FCF net of it.
review.reason_cheap_for_growth_help: Forward P/E at or under 1x its sustained sales growth per share: a PEG on the app's own growth, not the feed's.
review.reason_peak_margin_help: Operating margin 1.5x its median of past years, sales fell in one of them and growth is slow: likely the cycle. Blocks add and buy.
review.reason_sales_falling_help: Sales down on a year ago and over the years: cheap may mean shrinking. Blocks add and buy.
review.reason_margin_falling_help: Operating margin down 5+ points and a quarter of its median over the years: pricing power fading. Blocks add and buy.
review.reason_earnings_falling_help: Analysts expect 10%+ lower earnings next year (forward P/E above trailing): the low P/E flatters. Blocks add and buy.
review.reason_cheap_on_one_reading_help: Price 50+ with only one cheap input; the rest say dear. No margin of safety, so no add or buy.
review.reason_trailing_pe_help: No analyst estimates: price is read against last year's earnings.
review.reason_priced_on_book_help: The feed gives one price reading: book value (P/B) joins as a second.
review.reason_financial_lens_help: Bank, insurer or asset manager: judged on ROE, earnings, book and dividend, not cash flow or EBITDA.
review.reason_reit_lens_help: Listed real estate: judged on book, earnings, dividend and margin. Debt up to 8x EBITDA is normal.
review.reason_utility_lens_help: Regulated network (power, gas, water): judged on ROE, earnings, debt, price and dividend, not ROIC or cash flow. Debt up to 5x EBITDA is fine.
review.reason_high_roe_help: Return on equity of 15% or more.
review.reason_low_roe_help: Return on equity under 8%: does not cover its cost of capital.
review.reason_dividend_help: Dividend yield of 4% or more. Counts toward price, never decides alone.
review.reason_payout_stretched_help: Pays out over 90% of earnings, or more than several years' free cash flow without earnings to back it. Blocks add and buy.
review.metric_payout_ratio_help: Share of earnings paid out as dividends.
review.pending: {count} name(s) still loading, they fill in a few seconds
